## Description

Two distinct empty-list forms exist: a zero-attribute entity `#1=ABSTRACT_PT()` and an empty typed parameter `IFCMEASURE(())`. Lexical layer accepts `#1=PRODUCT();` but the schema expects N attributes.

## Reproducer recipe

`#1=BOUNDED_SURFACE();` versus `#2=IFCMEASURE(IFCLENGTHMEASURE());`

## Expected kernel behavior

Lex layer accepts `()` as zero-argument record; semantic layer must reject if schema requires N>0 with "0 attributes, expected N". Reject zero-argument typed parameters unless the schema explicitly permits.
